project: San Jie Class (July 2026) Hero Kai x 17 Photographed Guardians
global_negative_contracts: Strictly 17 photographed students (Tan Jie Khe Jacob excluded; Ko Zi Xing has no photo in Name Card.pdf).
Hero Kai Normal 4.0H Genome v5.0 locked (sword-free default, Tzu Chi winged-lotus emerald shield buckle, String + Baby Praying Mantis only, Zero Ember).
100% plant-based eco-friendly world (zero meat/non-veg props, zero modern plastic or guns).
100% text-free raw AI artwork — composite all English + Traditional Chinese typography deterministically via Python/WeasyPrint.
Always anchor new generations to MASTER_BOARD_01 (17 Students), MASTER_BOARD_02 (17 Pets), and MASTER_BOARD_03 (17 Relics) + individual turnaround sheets to guarantee 1:1 visual lock.
